collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A child watches seabirds and asks whether people elsewhere might build machines to cross the sky.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A child watches seabirds and asks whether people elsewhere might build machines to cross the sky.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The researchers study lift in bird wings and make a small harmless gliding model.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Their first model dives straight into the sand; the children demand another trial.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar proposes a great bag of heated air carrying a basket, then admits many practical questions remain.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The village debates whether storms would make such travel too dangerous.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A parent imagines distant relatives reaching one another sooner.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A fisher wonders whether rapid travel could also spread conflict or disease; the question sobers the group.
